description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractSinglePredicate' for implementing single-valued predicate logic within a MongoDB query context. It provides common functionality such as storing a value, equality checks, hash code generation, and string representation, meant to be extended by concrete predicate classes.

classes.name: AbstractSinglePredicate
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for predicates that operate on a single value, including storage of the value, equality comparison, hash code implementation, and a string representation.

methods.name: AbstractSinglePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a specified value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the encapsulated value of the predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality by comparing the encapsulated value with that of another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the encapsulated value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation including class name and value.
